Cover each scene. The script is what happens; you decide the camera setups in this director's style, and place every spoken line in the shot it is spoken in. Copy sceneNumber from the "## Scene N" headings.

<DIRECTOR_STYLE>
Mood: Authentic and immediate
Camera: Handheld camera with observational framing
References: vertiginous big-wall climbing documentary; unflinching observational documentary portraiture; tense vérité whistleblower documentary
</DIRECTOR_STYLE>

<CHARACTERS>
- MARA
- DEV
- SPOKESPERSON
</CHARACTERS>

<SCENES>
## Scene 1 — NEWSROOM
INT. NEWSROOM - NIGHT
shots: up to 14

INT. NEWSROOM - NIGHT

MARA, a tired editor in a green cardigan, stares at a monitor. DEV, a young reporter, rushes in with a laptop.

DEV
We have the leaked memo. It names the mayor.

MARA
Then we run it at six.

---

## Scene 2 — CITY HALL STEPS
EXT. CITY HALL STEPS - MORNING
shots: up to 11

EXT. CITY HALL STEPS - MORNING

MARA and DEV climb the steps past a row of cameras. A spokesperson blocks the door.

SPOKESPERSON
No comment.

MARA
We did not ask a question yet.
</SCENES>

Respond with ONLY valid JSON matching the schema.
